predecessors.name: Almoravid dynasty
predecessors.text: Tejada in the present-day Province of Huelva; the circle (27 km, 2,250 km2) is the researcher's reading of 'Tejada, Huelva', with Cliopatria's area

successors.name: Almohad Caliphate
successors.text: Tejada, 'conquered by the Almohad Caliphate' in 1150

ledger.x: 1146: Yusuf al-Bitruyi's Taifa of Tejada is founded.
1150: the Taifa of Tejada ends; infobox 'Succeeded by: Almohad dynasty'.

wars.name: Almohad conquest of al-Andalus
wars.outcome: Tejada fell to the Almohads in 1150, in the conquest in which 'the Almohads gradually wrested control from the Almoravids over the Muslim principalities in Iberia' between 1146 and 1173.

certainty.note: The page names only the capital and the province; the extent is a circle of Cliopatria's area.
